title: Jordan Stephens (Cohearity co-founder) — Salad and Go's collapse as 'a cautionary tale right out of that book'
summary: Jordan Stephens — co-founder of Cohearity (with Jim Driscoll) — reads Incorruptible and applies it to the Salad and Go rise-and-fall as a cautionary tale, using the book to sharpen what he needs to do to not lose sight of the 'why' behind his own company.
blockquote: I can't help but think about why I started my own company Cohearity with Jim Driscoll and what we need to do to not lose sight of or control over that 'why.' I just finished Incorruptible by Eric Ries, and the rise and fall of Salad and Go feels like a cautionary tale right out of that book.
